name: grimlib_GameInitialize
comment: Fills the engine module interface and registers the two Lua/engine callback tables (8 + 6 entries) Original name grimlib_GameInitialize (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the module-interface filler Main_Startup calls with hs and ms, same slots (itself, terminate, grimlib_GameStartup, shutdown) and base-module loop); was EngineModule_Init.

name: grimlib_GameTerminate
comment: Module interface slot 1 (EngineModule): called by Engine_ResetSubsystems / when registration fails; drops the service table pointer and clears the initialised flag. Original name grimlib_GameTerminate (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the terminate slot grimlib_GameInitialize fills, same body (clears psputmHS, undoes the modules when bsputmInitialize)); was EngineModule_Terminate.

name: grimlib_GameShutdown
comment: Module interface slot 3 (EngineModule): called by Engine_ShutdownSubsystems in reverse order; releases what _Start created. Original name grimlib_GameShutdown (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the shutdown slot grimlib_GameInitialize fills (shuts the modules down in reverse)); was EngineModule_Stop.

name: rdRaster_Startup
comment: Fills the 1/n float table and its fixed-point twin used by the span rasterizer Original name rdRaster_Startup (the remaster's GrimFandango (Linux): the last call of rdStartup, same body (rdRaster_aOneOverNFlex / rdRaster_aOneOverNFixed tables from 0x7f7fc99e / 0x7fffffff)); was rdroid_BuildMathTables.
